GRADE [C] The run_cmd placeholder hazard is now an operating rule in the file header: a capture is valid only if lean reported NO error for BinderAudit.lean, because elaboration errors leave placeholders and a green parse can hide an audit that never ran. No unsafe or #eval path is used to force execution.

GRADE [C] SUBSTANTIVE CORRECTION: v2 asserted the predicate aliases retain StandardBorelSpace Y and Nonempty Y. The accepted #check shows FiniteEncodingApproximationAt carries only MeasurableSpace X, MeasurableSpace Y and IsProbabilityMeasure mu with three type parameters. The root cause is structural -- the instance set was read off the variable block instead of the declaration header; Lean keeps only what the declaration needs, and W is needed by none because it occurs only through coeff : W -> Fin r -> C.

GRADE [C] binder_expected.json schema 3: the three definitions are FROZEN to {MeasurableSpace X, MeasurableSpace Y, IsProbabilityMeasure mu}, type binders X Y W (plus Z for EncodingApproximationAt), explicit mu p q b m gamma (mu p P S b m gamma for the core). The two theorems are UNFROZEN: enforced are only the forbidden StandardBorelSpace Y / Nonempty Y, the type binders X Y W and the 20-name explicit sequence; the instance multiset is printed as FREEZE-CANDIDATE for a one-time freeze.

GRADE [C] Comparator v3 supports both modes: frozen declarations get multiset equality against instance_allowed with UNKNOWN EXTRA INSTANCE and ABSENT required instance as FAILs; unfrozen ones print their observed instance multiset and pass unless a forbidden entry, a strict binder, a type-binder mismatch or an explicit-sequence mismatch occurs. Absent declarations and ERROR lines remain fail-closed in both modes.

GRADE [C] COMPARATOR EXERCISED ON SYNTHETIC CAPTURES ONLY: a capture built to the actual definition header gives SUMMARY fails=0 with FREEZE-CANDIDATE instances [MeasurableSpace X, MeasurableSpace Y, MeasurableSpace W, IsProbabilityMeasure mu] for both theorems and correct Z placement for EncodingApproximationAt; a negative capture gives FORBIDDEN on StandardBorelSpace Y and Nonempty Y, UNKNOWN INSTANCE on PolishSpace Y against a frozen definition, ABSENT (fail closed) for MISSING and FAIL for ERROR. This validates the comparator, not the tree.

GRADE [S] Accepted integration evidence, reported earlier and NOT re-run or reopened here: R4 82-module build PASS, 9 exported-root axiom checks PASS, R5 SignatureEquivalence and SignatureCheckFresh PASS with 4+4 standard axiom prints and no sorry.
GRADE [R] Scope unchanged: certifying the supplied OpenAI proof yields chi(R^2) >= 6 as already stated; it creates no new plane bound, and chi(R^2) in {6,7} remains open.
conjectures: The flip of 'default' to explicit is the most likely remaining compile risk, since the enum has exactly four constructors and the match is now exhaustive.
If MessageData.toString turns out to be IO-based rather than CoreM-based, liftCoreM becomes liftIO; that is a one-token change in a 102-line file.

The theorem instance multisets will most likely be {MeasurableSpace X, MeasurableSpace Y, MeasurableSpace W, IsProbabilityMeasure mu}; whether MeasurableSpace W is genuinely a binder is exactly what the freeze step decides, and it is not worth guessing again.
